tasks.subject: Task 1: Feed shows only unread
tasks.description:
Add Document.seen, deserialize it, drop seen=true docs from the Feed (Library untouched). Files: readwise/mod.rs, generate.rs (drop_seen), literal fixups in assemble.rs/tests/assemble.rs/examples/make_test_pdf.rs, tests/readwise.rs + tests/generate.rs.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Index nav bar on every index page (paging)
tasks.description:

tasks.subject: Task 3: Mark-all-read button + manifest recovery
tasks.description:
Render a bordered recoverable button under the Feed masthead (Feed only), recover its rect into the embedded manifest. Files: manifest.rs (MarkAllReadRect + field), render/typst_doc.rs (MARK_ALL_READ_LABEL, build_index feed flag, region), render/mod.rs (Rendered.mark_all_read + recovery), generate.rs (set field), literal fixups in tests/classify.rs/embed.rs/examples/readback_overlay.rs, tests/render.rs.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rmreader/src/manifest.rs", "crates/rmreader/src/render/typst_doc.rs", "crates/rmreader/src/render/mod.rs", "crates/rmreader/src/generate.rs", "crates/rmreader/tests/render.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p rmreader && cargo build -p rmreader --examples", "acceptanceCriteria": ["EmbeddedManifest.mark_all_read added", "Feed index emits region recovered into manifest", "Library index emits none"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Classify button highlights into seen_doc_ids
tasks.description:
A highlight over the button (stroke geometry on its page, or snap-to-text of its label) sets Plan.seen_doc_ids to every manifest doc id. Files: readback/classify.rs (Plan.seen_doc_ids; helpers; text + stroke detection), tests/classify.rs.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rmreader/src/readback/classify.rs", "crates/rmreader/tests/classify.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p rmreader --test classify", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Plan.seen_doc_ids added", "stroke on button → all ids", "text label → all ids", "non-button stroke does not trigger"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Readwise mark_seen (bulk_update) + execute wiring
tasks.description:
Send seen=true for doc ids via PATCH /api/v3/bulk_update/ in chunks of ≤50; call from execute(). Files: readwise/mod.rs (BULK_UPDATE_URL + mark_seen), readback/mod.rs (execute), tests/readwise.rs.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rmreader/src/readwise/mod.rs", "crates/rmreader/src/readback/mod.rs", "crates/rmreader/tests/readwise.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p rmreader --test readwise", "acceptanceCriteria": ["mark_seen PATCHes bulk_update with seen:true", "empty is no-op", "chunks at 50", "execute calls mark_seen when ids present"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```
